title: Community garden build, twelve week schedule
subtitle: Three workstreams running at once. The dependencies are what make the schedule tight, not the total effort.
intent: Learners can read a schedule for parallel work and identify which tasks sit on the critical path.

tasks.label: Council permit
tasks.note: Six weeks is the statutory maximum and nothing on site can begin without it. This is the critical path.

tasks.label: Volunteer induction
tasks.note: Cannot run before recruitment closes, and must finish before anyone is on site.

tasks.label: Install irrigation
tasks.note: Overlaps the bed build deliberately, because the plumber is only available in week 9.

milestones.label: Permit granted, site work can start
